name: git-profile-sync
description: Dynamically switch Git commit author, GitHub push credentials, and PortableGit/<username> repositories with zero identity mismatch.

commands.title: Git Profile: Switch Profile & Sync Workspace
Git Profile: Sync & Auto-Clone All GitHub Repos to PortableGit
Git Profile: Organize Existing PortableGit Repos into Profile Folders
Git Profile: Verify Active Identity & GitHub Token
Git Profile: Open Active Profile Folder in VS Code

gitProfileSwitch.portableGitRoot.description: Root path to PortableGit where per-user folders (PortableGit/<username>/<repos>) are stored. Leave blank to auto-detect dynamically for the current OS user.

gitProfileSwitch.profiles.description: Saved Git profiles (tokens are stored encrypted in VS Code SecretStorage).

gitProfileSwitch.autoCloneOnSwitch.description: Automatically fetch and clone missing GitHub repositories into PortableGit/<username> when switching profiles.

gitProfileSwitch.autoOpenProfileWorkspac.description: Whether to switch the VS Code Explorer workspace to PortableGit/<username> after switching profiles.

gitProfileSwitch.autoDetectFromRepo.description: Automatically detect and apply the matching Git profile based on the open repository path or remote owner.
